name: sequential-thinking
title: Sequential thinking (official MCP server)
description: The official MCP sequential-thinking server (@modelcontextprotocol/server-sequential-thinking 2.0.0): one tool, sequentialthinking, with which an agent writes down its reasoning as numbered thoughts - each can revise an earlier one or branch from it - and gets back the counts (thought number, estimated total, branches, length of the history). The thoughts are kept in memory for one connection only: nothing is read or written, nothing survives a restart. No network.
license: Apache-2.0 AND MIT (modelcontextprotocol/servers, in transition from MIT to Apache-2.0); MCP TypeScript SDK: Apache-2.0; zod, chalk: MIT; Node.js: MIT
notes: Useful for agents on capable models that do not reason natively, or to make a long chain of reasoning visible step by step; models with their own reasoning gain little, and small local models tend to keep thinking instead of acting - for those, the tasks server keeps a plan on disk. The model sets thoughtNumber, totalThoughts and nextThoughtNeeded itself; the server only counts and keeps the history until the connection ends. Thought logging to stderr is switched off in the image.
